cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've held up the hall keys like you. Tell the committee I'm the one who decides now, before your retirement taxi leaves.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I held them up to find the taxi key. You can have the hall key; let me get my coat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, sorting the keys. Put the hall key in my hand and tell them to bring their decisions to me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're asking me now whether Saturday's dance is cancelled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them 'Ask Jo; Jo decides.' Then ask me about the dance while they're listening.
